Taking its name from the locality, it is also called '''Suzaki Ryō Shrine''' (すざきりょうじんじゃ). {{nihongo|'''Ryou Shrine'''|両神社 (下田市)}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

== Overview ==
It is enshrined in the southeastern part of Shimoda City, in the central area of the Suzaki district, immediately north of Suzaki Port.

The date of establishment is unknown, but it is an ancient shrine that is considered a candidate shrine (ronsha) for the {{ill|Shikinaisha|lt=Shikinaisha|qid=Q134917286}} '''Sakitamahime-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (さきたまひめのみことじんじゃ) and '''Hotsusake-no-Mikoto Shrine''' (ほつさけのみことじんじゃ)<ref name="gen">[https://genbu.net/data/izu/ryou_title.htm Ryō Shrine] - Genmatsuko</ref><ref name="engi">[http://engishiki.org/izu/bun/iz140105-04.html Ryō Shrine] - Survey of Engishiki Shrines</ref>.
